|| Om, even this is remembered: Om || 1/3/23 ||

“[Know that] when the sun illuminates the entire world with its radiance, and when the moon and fire shine, that radiance is to be known as mine.”

And also: “The sun does not illuminate that, nor the moon, nor fire. That abode, to which, having gone, one does not return, is my supreme abode.”
